newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hebron University reopens in defiance of Israel.
newsitem.headline: Hebron University reopens in defiance of Israel.

text.p: The director of Hebron University defied an Israeli closure order by reopening the institution on Saturday at a new location in the city, Palestinian sources said.
Since the campus was tightly shut by Israeli troops, Director Nabil al-Jaabari rented a building in Hebron. On Saturday, registration of students began at the new site.
Israeli soldiers surrounded the building and harassed students who queued to register for the new semester, but there were no clashes, witnesses said.
Israel closed the university in March after the first of a wave of suicide bombings by Moslem militants opposed to the PLO-Israel peace deal that killed 59 people in Israel.

Under the interim PLO-Israel interim agreement, Israel handed over six major West Bank cities to Palestinians, but redeployment of Israeli troops in Hebron, planned for March, was delayed after the suicide attacks.
